preconditions.description: The number of suspects n is between 1 and 100,000, and the number of truthful answers m is between 0 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and line[0] in '+-' and 1 <= int(line[1:]) <= n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the n answer lines is either '+ai' or '-ai' where ai is an integer between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(line in ['Truth', 'Lie', 'Not defined'] for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'Truth', 'Lie', or 'Not defined'.
The output has exactly n lines, one for each suspect.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.splitlines()[i] == 'Truth' and all((stdin.splitlines()[i+1][0] == '+' and int(stdin.splitlines()[i+1][1:]) == criminal) or (stdin.splitlines()[i+1][0] == '-' and int(stdin.splitlines()[i+1][1:]) != criminal) for criminal in range(1, n+1) if sum(1 for j in range(n) if ((stdin.splitlines()[j+1][0] == '+' and int(stdin.splitlines()[j+1][1:]) == criminal) or (stdin.splitlines()[j+1][0] == '-' and int(stdin.splitlines()[j+1][1:]) != criminal)) == m))) or (stdout.splitlines()[i] == 'Lie' and all(not ((stdin.splitlines()[i+1][0] == '+' and int(stdin.splitlines()[i+1][1:]) == criminal) or (stdin.splitlines()[i+1][0] == '-' and int(stdin.splitlines()[i+1][1:]) != criminal)) for criminal in range(1, n+1) if sum(1 for j in range(n) if ((stdin.splitlines()[j+1][0] == '+' and int(stdin.splitlines()[j+1][1:]) == criminal) or (stdin.splitlines()[j+1][0] == '-' and int(stdin.splitlines()[j+1][1:]) != criminal)) == m))) or (stdout.splitlines()[i] == 'Not defined') for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each suspect i, the output line is 'Truth' if their statement is true for all possible criminals that satisfy the m-truth condition, 'Lie' if their statement is false for all such criminals, and 'Not defined' otherwise.
